text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her debut race was scheduled for 1800m on 
turf. Her condition was fully prepared. 
However, Neo Universe insisted that she 
should avoid this race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taking that into account, we decided to 
take on the 1600m turf race. Though 
slightly outside her optimal distance— 
would our "first contact" be a success?
